name: sgm_uniform
plain: Spaces timesteps evenly from the top to the bottom of the model's range using steps+1 points, drops the last one, converts each to sigma and appends 0. Compared with normal it never lands on the lowest timestep before the zero.
math:
t_i = linspace(t(σmax), t(σmin), steps+1)[:-1]; σ_i = model.sigma(t_i); final 0.
On a discrete model t(σ) is an argmin index and sigma(t) log-interpolates between neighbouring table entries.
